messages:
incident-bot: PAGER: high error-rate spike on /v1/generate in us-west-2. Severity: sev3. Auto-runbooks triggered. Please ack and report status.

alice_oncall: ack'd. Seeing 12% 5xx over last 3m, latency normal. Starting investigation.

ben_sre: on it — looking at ingress LB and autoscaler metrics. tagging as live-mitigation.

alice_oncall: quick mitigation: flipped to fallback model pool for critical customers (route policy v2). monitoring errors.

carla_prod: noted customer-facing errors for a small set of enterprise keys (org: ChalkRiver). Emily, do we need comms?

emily_englead: hold until we understand blast radius. If the fallback keeps success rate >98% we'll delay comms.

ben_sre: root cause signal: backend embedder queue backlog and a couple of pod restarts tied to OOM in embedder service. Temporary hotspot on shard 7.

alice_oncall: mitigation checklist executed: 
- rerouted traffic to compatible shard replicas
- killed and recreated affected embedder pods
- bumped embedder pool from 4->6 for shard 7
observed error rate drop to 1.1% after actions.

carla_prod: thanks. Can we schedule a postmortem + remediation plan? Need clear action items for customer credit calculation.

ben_sre: proposing postmortem tomorrow 09:30 PT. Agenda: timeline, root cause, action items, owner + size, rollout to prod, validation plan.

dave_pm: 09:30 PT works for me. We should prioritize a permanent fix (embedder OOM hardening) and a routing fallback improvement. Tie remediation to Q3 reliability OKR.

emily_englead: agree. Let's create action items now so owners can start sizing. Quick drafts: 
- ACTION 1: embedder OOM root fix (heap/GC tuning + memory cap) — Owner: ben_sre — size: L 
- ACTION 2: shard replica auto-heal improvement (faster rebuild) — Owner: alice_oncall & eng-infra — size: M 
- ACTION 3: routing policy enhancement to prefer warmed replicas for enterprise keys — Owner: carla_prod + eng-platform — size: S
- ACTION 4: incident runbook update & playbook test (simulate shard hotspot) — Owner: emily_englead — size: M

alice_oncall: I'll start a ticket for ACTION 2 and add runbook steps. ETA staging validation in 2 weeks.

ben_sre: started ACTION 1 ticket and pushed initial hypothesis + reproducer. Marking as L (4 sprint points).

carla_prod: ACTION 3 is higher priority for enterprise SLAs, I'll scope and add to roadmap with product tag. Size S (1).

dave_pm: for quarterly planning: recommend we put ACTION 1 in the next reliability sprint, ACTION 2 in infra backlog next sprint, ACTION 3 as a Q3 quick win, ACTION 4 as part of oncall drills for this quarter.

emily_englead: can someone own customer communication if we need to credit ChalkRiver? Carla?

carla_prod: I'll draft comms after postmortem; will coordinate with support on credit calc.

alice_oncall: note for postmortem: include metric artifact links and the fallback routing hash and keys used. I'll attach logs.

incident-bot: Postmortem scheduled: 1777863400 (tomorrow 09:30 PT). Link: https://redwood.slack/pm/postmortem/1777863400 (placeholder).

ben_sre: one more: recommend a small monitoring alert tweak — surface embedder queue depth per shard to SRE dashboards. ACTION 5: dashboard + alert — Owner: ben_sre — size: S.

emily_englead: thanks team. Closing live mitigation. Follow-ups assigned above; we'll review sizing in the postmortem and tag into sprint planning. :thumbsup:

alice_oncall: closing thread for live mitigation handoff. See you at postmortem.
